title: Residential Support Worker, Autism
summary: Provide person-centred support to people with autism in a residential home, helping them live independently and with dignity.
body:
## The position

We're seeking a compassionate, dedicated residential support worker to support individuals with autism in a residential home in Essex. You'll provide person-centred support that helps residents live independently, safely and with dignity.

You'll play a key role in supporting daily routines, promoting independence and keeping the home safe, structured and positive.

## The role

- Provide high-quality, person-centred care and support to residents with autism.
- Support residents with daily living, including meals, routines and personal care where required.
- Promote independence, life skills and emotional wellbeing.
- Follow care plans, behaviour support plans and risk assessments.
- Keep accurate records and daily reports.
- Support activities, social engagement and community access where appropriate.
- Always follow safeguarding and health and safety procedures.

## About you

You're passionate about supporting people with autism and committed to making a positive difference to their lives. You understand the importance of structure, consistency and empathy.

- Experience with autism, SEND or residential care (preferred, not essential).
- A compassionate, patient and reliable approach.
- Strong communication and teamwork skills.
- The ability to stay calm in challenging situations.
- The right to work in the UK.
- An enhanced DBS (or willingness to obtain one).

## What's on offer

- Competitive hourly rate.
- Full training and ongoing professional development.
- A supportive management team.
- Career progression opportunities.
- Rewarding, meaningful work.
